items.html: And the matter is, that first the first pregnancy of Katnut enters, namely the NHY included in the HGT. And afterward, the nursing of Katnut enters, namely the expansion of the NHY and HGT, each one by itself. And these aspects will never be lacking from me. However, when he is in the first pregnancy, when the NHY of Tevuna entered the HBD of ZA, then he has no Daat, as mentioned elsewhere, because there is no external vessel for the Yesod of Tevuna. And afterward, in the nursing, the HGT entered the HBD of ZA, and the NHY descended into the HGT of ZA; then he has the three Mochin of nursing. And this is always so in ZA.
